```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

  
  data<-data.frame(read.delim('~/OncobiomeNumbers2.tsv', header=T, sep='\t'))



  #pal=met.brewer('Hiroshige',nrow(data))[1:nrow(data)]
  pal=met.brewer('Monet',nrow(data))[1:nrow(data)]
  names(pal)=data$id

  fig=plot_ly(data, ids = ~id, labels = ~labels, parents = ~parent, type = 'sunburst', hovertext=~values, branchvalues='total', marker = list(colors = pal) )

  fig
```
